PZZ700-212200-
223 AM PDT Wed Oct 21 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1011 mb high was over Guadalupe Island, a 1008 mb low
was over the mouth of the Colorado River, and another 1008 mb low
was 600 nautical miles west of Ensenada, associated with a storm
system moving into the coastal waters today. Southerly flow will 
increase this morning and continue brisk through tonight as the 
storm system moves through the coastal waters. There is a slight 
chance of thunderstorms this afternoon through Thursday. 
Southerly winds will become westerly Thursday. Weak offshore flow 
during the nights and mornings will alternate with onshore 
northwest flow during the afternoons and evenings Friday night 
through Sunday.

$$
